title: Mexican Chicken Casabe Wrap
description: A twist on traditional Mexican cuisine, this recipe combines the crunch of casabe with the tenderness of sous vide chicken, all wrapped up in a soft tortilla.
instructions: Preheat the sous vide machine to 130°F (54°C).
Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Place the chicken breasts in a sous vide bag with the buttermilk.
Seal the bag and cook for 2 hours.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the vegetable oil and sear the chicken breasts for 2 minutes per side.
Warm the tortilla wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the cooked chicken breasts and placing them on the tortilla, followed by a spoonful of salsa.
Top with a piece of casabe and serve immediately.
